verdict.rationale: Ramp's data can be pulled out programmatically in open formats. The Developer API is described by a parseable OpenAPI schema with 174 paths, including transactions, and the CLI emits JSON in agent mode across 12 resources. The AI agents guide also mentions pulling "full spend exports" for admins, and accounting syncs push transactions, bills and reimbursements into QuickBooks, NetSuite and Xero. This is piecemeal extraction rather than a documented full-account export-and-leave path. Missing for 10: a documented one-step bulk export of all account data, explicit open file formats (e.g. CSV) for exports, confirmation that every data type (receipts, audit logs, policies) is exportable, an offboarding or account-closure data-portability process, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
